Recently, Amazon Web Services (AWS) invested $1 billion to establish an "AI on-site engineer" team—a heavy-asset move that seems to reverse historical trends, sparking considerable controversy in the tech circle. For a long time, international cloud giants favored the narrative of "extreme standardization": opening public cloud API interfaces and simply collecting profits. Heavy-duty on-site services? Basically nonexistent. But in 2026, this model of easily selling standardized products may be changing. AWS is spending $1 billion to form a team of thousands of "embedded AI engineers," or FDEs (Field Deployment Engineers), who will directly enter client offices to help enterprises implement agents and build AI production systems hands-on. This is not an isolated case. Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and other AI and cloud giants have heavily established FDE positions or specialized companies in the past six months, with total investments exceeding tens of billions of RMB. Domestically, Alibaba, ByteDance, Tencent, and other major model and cloud providers have also rapidly built up "on-site iron forces" in the first half of this year. "Deep on-site," "high-end outsourcing," "IT construction team"—these somewhat negative, outdated labels are now reappearing in the narratives of AI and cloud giants. Why are the cloud giants, once keen on easy profits, suddenly enthusiastic about on-site customer service in the AGI era? Will they repeat the mistakes of domestic cloud giants?

items.title: 苹果 Vision Pro 副总裁 Paul Meade 跳槽 OpenAI
items.raw_excerpt: 据彭博社报道，苹果公司负责 Vision Pro 团队的副总裁保罗·米德（Paul Meade）即将离职，加入 OpenAI 的硬件团队。此举与苹果新 CEO 上任后进行人事调整、导致保罗·米德“变相降级”有关。 随着约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）接替库克出任苹果下一任 CEO，原芯片业务掌门人约翰尼·斯鲁吉（Johny Srouji）被提拔为首席硬件官。 斯鲁吉上任后对硬件工程部门进行了颇具争议的激进重组：保罗·米德以及其他几位硬件副总裁，被要求向新任硬件工程副总裁汤姆·马里布（Tom Marieb）汇报，而马里布再向斯鲁吉汇报。 这种管理层级的增加，让保罗·米德等高管感觉自己被“变相降级”，从而引发了离职。 据了解，保罗·米德在苹果工作了超过 15 年，早期负责过 iPad 和 iPhone 的项目管理。自 2017 年起他就加入了 Vision Products Group，并在过去 7 年中深度主导了 Vision Pro 的硬件工程开发。 在离职前，他正带领团队秘密研发苹果对标 Meta Ray-Ban 的第一款无显示屏智能眼镜，该产品原计划于 2027 年底发布。 米德离职后，其原职位将由其长期副手、现任 Vision Pro 和智能眼镜产品设计负责人弗莱彻·罗斯科普夫（Fletcher Rothkopf）接任。 OpenAI 为何招募米德？业内普遍认为，这背后是 OpenAI 硬件战略正从“设计概念”走向“工业制造”。 一年前，OpenAI 已经以 65 亿美元的巨额交易收购了由苹果前首席设计官乔尼·艾夫（Jony Ive）等人创立的 AI 硬件初创公司 io。 相比于乔尼·艾夫团队更偏向外观设计与产品哲学的风格，保罗·米德的加入为 OpenAI 带来了最缺乏的硬核工程能力——如何把极其复杂的传感器、低延迟架构、空间计算组件塞进一个紧凑的消费级设备里。

excerpt_i18n.en: According to Bloomberg, Apple Vice President Paul Meade, who led the Vision Pro team, is leaving to join OpenAI's hardware team. This move is linked to a "de facto demotion" following personnel changes after Apple's new CEO took office. As John Ternus succeeded Tim Cook as Apple's next CEO, former chip chief Johny Srouji was promoted to chief hardware officer. items.raw_excerpt: 7 月 7 日，支付宝上线AI 开放平台并面向商家、服务商等合作伙伴启动邀测。记者获悉，新瑞鹏集团正受邀参与支付宝AI生态内测，升级养宠服务的智能化体验。 随着双方适配测试推进，未来用户将可用语音快捷唤起养宠服务。在对AI版支付宝“阿宝”说出需求之后，即通过 “安心生活” 服务卡片直达新瑞鹏集团旗下品牌门店的专属服务页面，省去多层页面跳转操作。未来依托平台多端分发能力，新瑞鹏集团宠物服务还可将服务授权通过“阿宝”，在车机、智能穿戴等终端同步上线，用户在多端智能入口都能线上预约宠物诊疗相关服务。 作为国内宠物行业龙头，新瑞鹏旗下拥有瑞鹏、美联众合、宠颐生、安安宠医、芭比堂等众多知名宠物医疗服务品牌，全国连锁宠物医院超千家，业务涵盖宠物诊疗、疫苗驱虫、健康体检、宠物用品等全生命周期服务。 新瑞鹏相关项目负责人韩雪表示，本次参与支付宝AI平台测试，是集团数智化升级的重要一步。未来将持续深挖 AI 交互场景，以智能交互升级养宠服务体验，探索宠物行业全新经营范式。

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 7, Alipay launched its AI Open Platform and initiated beta testing with merchants, service providers, and other partners. According to reports, New Ruipeng Group is invited to participate in the internal testing of Alipay's AI ecosystem to upgrade the intelligent experience of pet care services. As the compatibility tests progress, users will soon be able to quickly access pet care services through voice commands. After speaking their request to Alipay's AI version, "Abao," users can directly access the exclusive service page of New Ruipeng Group's brand stores via the "Anxin Life" service card, eliminating multiple page jumps. In the future, leveraging the platform's multi-terminal distribution capabilities, New Ruipeng Group's pet services can also be authorized through "Abao" and simultaneously deployed on terminals such as vehicle systems and smart wearables, allowing users to book pet diagnosis and treatment services online through various intelligent entry points. Its business covers the entire life cycle of pet services, including diagnosis and treatment, vaccination and deworming, health checkups, and pet supplies. Han Xue, head of the relevant project at New Ruipeng, stated that participating in the Alipay AI platform test is a significant step in the group's digital and intelligent upgrade. In the future, it will continue to explore AI interaction scenarios to enhance the pet care service experience through intelligent interaction and explore new operational models for the pet industry.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On July 7, the Alipay AI Open Platform officially launched and initiated ecological invitation testing for merchants and service providers. Leveraging its core capabilities of "one-time access, multi-terminal distribution, and unified management," it aims to open omnichannel intelligent terminal commercial pathways for merchants. Ruichen Pet Hospital Group, a leading chain pet medical brand in China, became one of the first industry partners to join this AI ecosystem, providing one-stop pet health and security services for pet-owning families nationwide on the AI version of Alipay "Abao."

Ruichen Pet Hospital Group is a large comprehensive enterprise primarily engaged in pet medical services with diversified development. The company coordinates "multi-integrated" development across pet medical care, laboratory diagnostics, pet grooming, pet commodity trade, and pet culture communication, covering multiple major links in the pet industry chain. The group has established 18 specialized departments: Imaging, Internal Medicine, Feline Medicine, Cardiology, Dermatology, Oncology, Exotic Pets, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, Dentistry, Neurology, Soft Tissue Surgery, Minimally Invasive Surgery, Hemodialysis, Anesthesia and Pain Management, Traditional Chinese Veterinary Medicine, Clinical Pathology, and Emergency and Critical Care. It operates over 150 outstanding pet hospitals in more than 50 large and medium-sized cities nationwide.

Simultaneously, Ruichen Pet Hospital Group has built a multi-dimensional talent training system and long-term incentive mechanism, enabling every veterinarian to fully utilize their talents and realize professional value. It continuously supplies and cultivates top-tier medical talent leading the industry's disciplines. Leveraging its national chain network, the group has developed an intelligent management platform, data middle platform, and other systems, achieving efficient operations.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 7 de julio, la plataforma abierta de IA de Alipay se lanzó oficialmente e inició una invitación ecológica para comercios y proveedores de servicios, apoyándose en la capacidad central de "una sola conexión, distribución multicanal, gestión unificada", con la intención de abrir un canal comercial integral para terminales inteligentes para los comercios. Ruichen Pet Hospital Group, como marca líder nacional de clínicas veterinarias en cadena, se convirtió en uno de los primeros socios del sector en unirse a este ecosistema de IA, creando un servicio integral de salud y tranquilidad para mascotas para los hogares con mascotas de todo el país en la versión de IA de Alipay "Abão". Ruichen Pet Hospital Group es una gran empresa integral diversificada cuyo negocio principal es el servicio médico para mascotas. La empresa se dedica a la atención médica de mascotas, diagnóstico de laboratorio, mascotas.
